issue.userReport: The installed TestFlight build 1.0.0 (2) appeared unclickable after sign-in.
issue.confirmedCause: An existing server-authorized developer grant was enabled, but Esha's billing status and installed native membership gate did not recognize it as app access.
issue.accountDataMinimization: No account email, user identifier, credentials, purchase rows or raw logs are included.
issue.scope: The entitlement defect and a separate auth-busy cancellation race are confirmed; a global touch-input freeze on the user device was not established.

statusContract.authority: Existing server-authenticated developer access; no client email or profile-role allowlist.

correction.storeMembership: Preserved as the truthful store entitlement, separate from developer app access.
correction.nativeBehavior: Accepts a fresh, same-account developer grant; retains verification expiry, refresh, revocation and account-switch guards; prevents redundant checkout and avoids optional storefront discovery for a verified developer.
correction.accountBehavior: Provides working entry to Esha after access verification and clears authentication busy state during session-loss recovery.
correction.paidAiAndVoice: Remain disabled; this correction does not bypass provider enablement or usage allowances.

releaseMetadataCorrection.purposeString: Esha’s voice conversations use only your microphone. Esha does not use your camera.

releaseStatus.limitation: The backend patch alone does not update installed build 2, which does not understand the new appAccess contract.
